floors.reason: Weak discriminator, flagged in the baseline report (controller ruling 2026-10-13, in place of the owner-approved breakdown counts; flagged to the owner): the contract grades three required facts (counts failed-total and top-count, required top-template) and two forbidden facts at weights 0.3/0.7, so an agent that makes the golden calls and asserts nothing keeps the two forbidden facts and collects 0.3 + 0.7 x 2/5 = 0.580 (mute), and one that makes no call collects 0.280 (nocall), above the 0.50 / 0.25 caps; the fabricate probe scores 0.300 (max 0.440, below mute). A reweight to 0.25/0.75 alone gives 0.550 / 0.300 and still fails. The owner-approved counts for the asked 'one-line breakdown per template' (fintech-count 18, telco-count 12, claims-count 8) were tried (d8bc265) and reverted, because fresh honest answers that state the breakdown correctly lost them: 3 of 13 fresh honest breakdown answers lost points (0.7375, 0.9125, 0.9125): a free-form breakdown can put a template's figure more than 6 tokens from its name (number-first lines, an inserted parenthetical, a long clause). So they were not kept.
